code:
from sklearn.model_selection import TimeSeriesSplit
import pandas as pd
fit_rows=(train|valid) & (X.index < "2026-07-31 20:00")
ix=X.index[fit_rows]
assert ix.max() < pd.Timestamp("2026-07-31 20:00")
for train_idx, valid_idx in TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=3).split(ix):
    issued=ix[valid_idx[0]].normalize()-pd.Timedelta(hours=4)
    safe=ix[train_idx][ix[train_idx] < issued]
    assert safe.max() < issued <= ix[valid_idx[0]]
    print(str(ix[valid_idx[0]]),str(safe.max()), len(train_idx)-len(safe))
assert X.index.max() < pd.Timestamp("2026-08-01")
for tr, va in TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=3,gap=28).split(ix):
    assert ix[tr[-1]] < ix[va[0]].normalize()-pd.Timedelta(hours=4)
print(ix.size, list(ix[[0,-1]].astype(str)))

def make_promo(index):

    m=HistGradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=0).fit(df.loc[train,columns],y[train])
    sq=(y[~train]-m.predict(df.loc[~train,columns]))**2
